evidence: Read all 56 criterion descriptions (2 gate, 44 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Every binary criterion states one conjunctive full-credit bar, ends with an explicit 'Fails if ...' list plus 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold', and none enumerates several legs and then waives most of them. The waiver-like sentences present are each a scoped permission or an explicit ownership pointer, not a second target: gates/render/judge.toml:25 'a refusal message is welcome but not required'; functional/judge.toml:31 hro_job_open 'any team, manager or places value the app shows for it matches' (display conditional, entry of all four fields is required) and 'Whether the places limit and the manager's rights work is graded only in hro_interview_full and the manager rows'; :58/:94/:166 'hiding it is optional' with server refusal still required; :139 hro_refused_put_back 'A UI that refuses before the card moves, with the reason shown and focus on that card, also passes' (alternative path keeps the same reason+focus bar); :175 'Whether the Observer's screens show such controls is the app's choice'; :202 hro_refusal_status 'only those that were refused count here ... If none of these replays was refused, this row is 0' (one defined bar: every refused replay carries the stated status and at least one was refused); :247/:265/:382/:391/:409 explicit 'graded only in <row>' ownership pointers; :274 hro_activity '(notes and messages need not appear in Activity ...; one line naming every card of a multi-card move with its stages also satisfies that move)' consistent with hireops_rules.md section 4 which lists only openings, additions, moves, rejections, reopenings, re-orderings and undo; polish/judge.toml:25 hro_pol_live_board scroll-leg waiver only under a stated, observable condition ('only if neither can be made to scroll with twelve cards in one stage, record that and judge the other legs'); :52 'a local not-sent marker is acceptable'; :61 'unless the sign-in prompt has already appeared on its own (that also passes)'. Visual likert rows (visual/judge.toml:25-92) each give a single 5-anchor scale on one aspect. This matches the workbook text and the Internal Quality Checks annotation (flows may bundle several verifiers) and the skill's false-positive note that conjunctive whole-flow bars are not a row-33 defect. Lessons file patterns bearing on this row (lesson 9 report each step; lesson 14 void handling; lesson 16 double grading) checked: functional/polish prompts carry 'Report every step' and the void-attempt rule, and criteria use 'graded only in' pointers rather than double bars. Minor instances found (both P3, neither a waiver of most legs, and a conforming app passes under either reading): (1) functional/judge.toml:148 hro_mgr_late_stages says the manager 'moves a card Interview to Offer to Hired and back', which naturally reads as back to Interview, while functional/prompt.md:53 protocol R says 'Interview→Offer→Hired and back to Offer'; an app that wrongly refuses a manager's Offer→Interview move would pass under the protocol reading and fail under the criterion reading. Also 're-orders cards within those stages' vs protocol 're-order cards in Offer or Interview'. (2) functional/prompt.md:57 protocol A parenthetical '(notes are not recorded in Activity)' could be read as a prohibition, whereas the criterion :274 says notes 'need not appear'; the criterion's Fails list does not penalise a note line, so the criterion itself is single-target. (3) polish/judge.toml:34 hro_pol_live_thread says 'This row owns the draft and focus' yet also grades 'The view stays at the newest message' with an explicit Fails clause; the explicit Fails clause makes the bar determinable, the ownership sentence is merely incomplete. Source-only row: no runtime measurement is required to decide it; no Oracle/model/portal score is claimed.
counterexample: Two-target probe for hro_mgr_late_stages: an app whose hiring manager can do Interview->Offer->Hired->Offer but is refused Offer->Interview (violating hireops_rules.md 'only among Interview, Offer and Hired' which permits it). A judge following protocol R passes the row; a judge following the criterion's 'and back' (to Interview) fails it. A conforming app (golden) passes under both readings, so no correct app is penalised. Plausible broken apps otherwise tried against the waiver sentences (an app showing only the job title, an app hiding refused controls, an app refusing a move before sending it) are still held to the full bar by each criterion's Fails list.
suggested_fix: Optional wording tidy: change hro_mgr_late_stages to 'moves a card Interview to Offer to Hired and back to Offer' (or add 'and Offer to Interview' to protocol R), drop or reword the protocol A parenthetical to 'notes need not appear in Activity', and change hro_pol_live_thread's ownership sentence to 'This row owns the draft, focus and staying at the newest message'.
